verdict.rationale: A probe confirms MotherDuck serves an llms.txt at motherduck.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and evidence items are sourced from a /docs/llms-full.txt bundle. Many doc pages are published as .md files, which agents can ingest directly. Missing for 10: first-party docs explaining how to point agents at llms.txt or the markdown docs, hands-on corroboration of agents using them, and consistent per-page markdown (the /getting-started/.md probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://motherduck.com/llms.txt # MotherDuck
AI Functions: Built-in LLM functions for text analysis, embeddings, and SQL generation
Cloud Storage Integration: Query data directly from S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage, and more
